text: 【卡塔尔一季度GDP同比萎缩7%】卡塔尔国家规划委员会8月31日表示，受地区地缘政治局势升级以及航运和出口受限影响，2026年第一季度卡塔尔油气产业国内生产总值（GDP）同比下降25.8%，拖累整体GDP同比萎缩7.0%。
text_en: Qatar Q1 GDP Shrinks 7% YoY: Qatar's National Planning Council said on Aug 31 that due to escalating regional geopolitical tensions and restrictions on shipping and exports, the oil and gas sector GDP fell 25.8% YoY in Q1 2026, dragging overall GDP down 7.0% YoY.
